title: Designing Safe
subtitle: Safety-first controllers prevent change storms and fix outages without erasing evidence.

panels.heading: The unsafe automation trap
panels.caption: Unbounded, noisy-triggered fixes oscillate, erase audit trails, and intensify impact.
panels.note: Wrong time, wrong scope, and no bounds turn help into harm.

panels.heading: Invariants that define safe
panels.caption: Least privilege, auditability, idempotence, reversibility, and bounded change.
panels.note: No single step may raise severity; preserve evidence outside the blast radius.

panels.heading: Guarded feedback controller
panels.caption: Act on user signals with thresholds, hysteresis, backoff, budgets, and vetted actions.
panels.note: Gate AI by policy; pace retries; timebox and shard to avoid herds.

strip_title: Blueprint for safe, fast auto-remediation in prod
strip_caption: Tie actions to user impact, pace retries, cap scope and duration, and record evidence.

steps.label: Choose user signals
steps.detail: Trigger on SLO and golden signals.

steps.label: Guard AI and verify
steps.detail: Vetted catalog; log inputs and results.
